{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: Big Hits of the 80's; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A broad decade compilation does not connect strongly enough with my recent listening to interest me.
ItemID: NA; Title: Corazon; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Santana's guitar playing appeals to the blues-rock interest reflected in my Clapton and Hendrix listening; I would try this.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Beatles 1967 1970; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The later Beatles material fits my interest in classic rock, but I would pass on a compilation this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Beatles; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The Beatles fit my classic-rock interests, but the title alone does not tell me which release this is.
ItemID: NA; Title: Greatest Hits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Without an artist name, I cannot tell whether this matches my taste.
ItemID: NA; Title: Wallflower; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: If this is Diana Krall's album, its familiar-song interpretations could appeal, but I am more interested in guitar-led music right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Lb - Kill The Lights; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My interest in Blown Away does not give me enough reason to choose this unfamiliar release.
ItemID: NA; Title: Patsy Cline's Greatest Hits; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Her expressive country singing appeals, but I am not looking for a classic-country compilation today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Norah Jones Day Breaks; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Her relaxed, roots-oriented sound could suit my listening, but I would save this for another visit.
